+from __future__ import (absolute_import, division, print_function)
+__metaclass__ = type
+
+import pytest
+
+from ansible.cli.doc import DocCLI
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('source, expected', [
+    ('L(Ansible,https://example.com)', 'Ansible <https://example.com>'),
+    ('L(Ansible, https://example.com)', 'Ansible <https://example.com>'),
+    ('R(Ansible,reference)', 'Ansible'),
+    ('R(Ansible, reference)', 'Ansible'),
+    ('before HORIZONTALLINE after', 'before \n-------------\n after'),
+    ('I(italic) B(bold) M(module) U(url) C(constant)', "`italic' *bold* [module] url `constant'"),
+    ('Use M(name), B(text), C(value), and R(label,ref).', "Use [name], *text*, `value', and label."),
+    ('IBM(International Business Machines) and XL(ordinary text)', 'IBM(International Business Machines) and XL(ordinary text)'),
+])
+def test_doc_tty_ify_renders_supported_macros_without_changing_plain_words(source, expected):
+    assert DocCLI.tty_ify(source) == expected
